_note: Machine-readable filters for the daily scan. Written by the setup skill from Profile/Search Profile.md; change both together (say 'update my search profile').
_first_scan_note: When a company is scanned for the first time, only roles posted in the last N days count as new; older ones are recorded as seen (skipped_first_scan_old).
first_scan_all_roles: _Must-have companies: their first scan lists roles from the last first_scan_must_have_max_days (14) instead of first_scan_max_days; older roles are never pursued. Filled by build-target-list.
yc_roles: _YC job board role categories to scan, from the URL ycombinator.com/jobs/role/<category>: e.g. product-manager, software-engineer, designer, sales-manager, marketing, operations, recruiting-hr, science, legal, finance. Setup fills this; empty means skip YC.
newsletters: _RSS feeds of newsletters that list companies hiring. Startup examples: https://nextplayso.substack.com/feed (startup jobs), https://alirohdejobs.substack.com/feed (startup ops, chief of staff and VC roles). Setup offers these when they fit the search; empty means skip.

title_include_needs._note: An include word listed here counts only if the title also has one of these words.
